game_title: Call Stack Tower – Frozen Well Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about stack_height to power up the hold guard and open the wall banner.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
